thread:
maria: Quick preflight for model v12 rollout — planning a bucketed canary + regional ramp. Starting 1% canary in eu-west-1 -> 5% -> 25% and then global. Need guardrails, circuit breaker, and the rollback playbook. @kevin can you confirm metric list?
kevin: Yep. Minimal checklist: flag name + buckets, obs dashboards, smoke prompts (5-10 prompts), alert thresholds. Watch p50/p95 latency, error_rate, and prompt-eval pass rate. Also validate KV cache warm-up on hotspots.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created feature-flag model/v12/bucketed at 1753337810 — initial bucket set: control=99, canary=1. Link: https://console.redwood/infer/flags/model/v12/bucketed
li: Add an emergency cutoff command in runbook: use `/toggle disable model/v12/bucketed` and also tag the rollout with `--no-burst` so autoscale doesn't exhaust quota. Suggest a cookie/user-agent seeded test group for manual QA.
anya: i'll wire the automatic rollback rule in the rollout config — propose rollback if error_rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 2s for 5m. Also add a quality regression check: eval pass rate drop > 4% vs baseline over 10m. Snippet i'll add to the PR:
```yaml
flag: model.v12.canary
strategy:
  type: bucketed
  buckets:
    - name: control
      pct: 99
    - name: canary
      pct: 1
cutover_regions: [eu-west-1, us-east-1]
rollback_conditions:
  - metric: error_rate_pct
    threshold: 2
    duration_mins: 5
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    threshold: 2000
    duration_mins: 5
quality_guard:
  eval_prompt_set: release_smoke_v12
  max_drop_pct: 4
```
kevin: Nice. Also add a manual gate step in the runbook: we bump to 5% only after 60m stable and a manual ack in the canary runbook. I'll add the dashboard links in the PR comments.
sam: LGTM. I'll be on pager watch for the first 90m and will ping when we bump. Ping me ~10m before each percent increase.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup: i'll open the PR and post the preflight doc at https://go/release/model-v12-canary and tag oncall. Will run the smoke prompts once the flag is live.
